# Agents Usage

> Free, open-source KDE Plasma 6 widget (plasmoid) that shows remaining usage quota and reset times for AI coding agents on Linux: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI, OpenCode and Ollama Cloud. MIT licensed, no telemetry, offline by default.

- Claude Code: five-hour, weekly, Sonnet and Opus windows via a local status-line collector or the optional Anthropic usage API.
- OpenAI Codex CLI: five-hour and weekly rate limits from local session events or a live query through the Codex CLI.
- OpenCode: provider quotas from a local export file.
- Ollama Cloud: session, weekly or credit usage from the ollama.com balance API.
